definition: An unspecified amount or number of.
exampleSentence: Would you like some warm tea?

definition: Used to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things.
exampleSentence: Do you have any questions about the homework?
How many books do you read in a month?
How much water do you drink every day?
We will leave in a few minutes.
There are a lot of students in our classroom.

definition: A small amount of an uncountable noun.
exampleSentence: Please put a little sugar in my cup.

definition: More than two but not many.
exampleSentence: I bought several English grammar books today.

definition: The whole quantity or extent of.
exampleSentence: All students must complete their homework.

definition: Every one of two or more considered individually.
exampleSentence: Each student has a dictionary on their desk.
